Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ds-you-overestimate-their-chances/ SWCCGcards], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ds_You_Overestimate_Their_Chances.png source photograph].
